notes: Added Outfit Collection automation with Collection and Inventory scanning, reviewed completion plans, selectable-pot acquisition, +2 synthesis, and verified Collection submission.
Added Auto Sell with full Inventory scanning, search, bound/unbound grouping, keep-count controls, review, split handling, and automated selling.
Added Low Purify Stone as an optional Outfit Collection upgrade material with reserve, run-limit, fallback, and 100% synthesis verification.
Added reliable outfit variant matching, Collection category routing, synthesis retry recovery, and stack-aware Auto Sell execution.
Improved scan reuse and slow-server handling across Collection, Inventory, pot selection, and synthesis workflows.

sections.title: New Features
items: Added Outfit Collection automation with Inventory, Collection, and outfit-pot scanning.
Added reviewed completion plans that show which missing outfits can be collected, upgraded, acquired from pots, or require manual synthesis.
Added selectable-pot acquisition with exact pot and outfit verification before use.
Added automatic +2 outfit synthesis with recovery when catalysts are consumed during an unsuccessful upgrade attempt.
Added verified Collection submission with category-aware routing, including outfits whose Collection category differs from their pot or visual rarity.
Added exact outfit variant matching for outfits that share underlying avatar assets or have different visual variants.
Added Low Purify Stone as an optional upgrade material with reserve, run-limit, fallback, and 100% synthesis verification.
Added Auto Sell with full Inventory scanning across tabs and stacks.
Added Auto Sell search, bound/unbound grouping, keep-count controls, review, split handling, stack relocation, and automated selling.

sections.title: Improvements
items: Reduced repeated Inventory and Collection scans by reusing verified scan results during execution.
Improved slow-server handling across Collection navigation, Inventory transitions, pot selection, and synthesis.
Refined sidebar organization and icons for Inventory workflows and Clan.
